tei:div.tei:p: 337) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: 'jam dpal rtsa sgrub bsdus pa shes rab blo 'phel bzhugs: 338)na mo mañdzu shrī ye: gang dag blo gros 'phel ba'i phyir: smra ba'i dbang phyug bsgrub pa la: skyabs su 'gro dang sems bskyed ni: na mo: mgon po kun gzigs 'jam dpal la: byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi: ma rig lam gol sems can kun: rnam grol lam 'god sems bskyed do: āḥ chos rnams rang bzhin rnam par bdag: stong nyid gdangs las snying rje'i rtsal: rig pa rgyu yi yi ger shar: 'od zer 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas: tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las: bde chen dag pa'i zhing khams su: lhun grub gzhal yas bkod pa rdzogs: de dbus pad+ma nyi zla'i steng: rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su: 339)mkhyen gzigs ye shes smra ba'i dbang: sku mdog dmar ser gur gum mdog: zhal gcig phyag gnyis ral gri po ti 'dzin: spyan gnyis 'gro tshogs kun la brtse bar gzigs: dbu skra thod bcings zur phud sil bur 'phyang: longs spyod rgyan rdzogs zhi 'dzum mtshan dpe ldan: zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs: ye shes 'od lnga'i 'ja' ris 'khyil ba'i klong: snang stong ye shes sgyu ma'i sku ru bsgom: de ltar gsal ba'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng: thugs srog dhiḥdang mtha' mar dbyangs yig ni: bcu drug bkrag 'bar g.yas 340)bskor tshul du gsal: dhīḥlas 'od 'phros rgyal mchod byin rlabs bsdus: srog gi snying por ro gcig 'dres pa yis: mi brjed gzungs spobs shes rab mchog thob nas: rgyal kun gsang gsum ye shes dbang 'byor bsam: dhīḥdhīḥdhīḥ ces mi tshig dag gis bar ma bcad: dmigs gnad ldan pa'i ngang nas bzla: bar skabs thugs srog khong gseng nas: dbyangs yig lu gu rgyud du 'phros: zhal gsang bar 'khor 'od zer gyis: rmongs pa'i sgrib pa kun bsal nas: ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes rgyas:

spobs pa'i gter dang blo gros gsal bar bsam: dbyangs yig lan bdun brjod nas thugs kar bsdu: de yis shes rab snang ba rgyas par 'gyur: mthar ni mchod cing bstod pa ni: oṃ: snang srid dag pa mchod pa'i sprin: phyi nang gsang mchod bsam mi khyab: 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la: gus pas 'bul lo dgyes par bzhes: ar+ghaṃ= shap+da rū pa= spar+she pra tīts+tsha pū dza āḥhūm̐ khā hi: hūm̐ hrīḥ dmar ser gur gum mdog 'chang bcom ldan 'das: 'jam dpal smra ba'i dbang po mkhyen rab bdag: bcu phrag bcu dang bcu gnyis rgyan gyis spras: rigs kun khyab bdag mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod: skye zhing tshe rabs thams cad dus kun tu: bla ma 'jam dpal dpa' bos 341)rjes bzung nas: lung rtogs chos kyi don rnams 'byed mkhas pa'i: blo gros spobs pa'i snang ba bdag la stsol: dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag nyid kyang: 'jam dpal smra ba'i ye shes 'grub gyur nas: 'gro ba sems can gcig kyang ma lus pa: kun gzigs kun mkhyen go 'phang thob par shog: ces dang smon lam 'grub sngags brjod: sa ma ya: de ltar tshul bzhin nyams blangs na: shes rab snang ba rgyas par 'gyur: bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal: skal ldan bu dang 'phrad par shog: skal med rnams la 'di ma 'phrad: bka' srung dregs pa'i tshogs kyis gnyer: thub par srungs shig sa ma ya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: brda thim: : ces snga 'gyur bstan pa'i gsal sgron mchog gi rig pa 'dzin pa zhabs drung skyabs mgon dam pa rin po ches lha reg dang phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis gzugs ris bcas gsung gi dbugs dbyung spyi bor phebs pa ldog ma nus par mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud las zhal bshus te/ lcags 'brug zla dang po tshes bcu bzhi dge bar su kha badz+ra gyis gtan la phab pa'i yi ge pa ni nye gnas shākya'i dge btsun tshul khrims rdo rjes bris so// dge'o// 342)
